column2: Umbhalo nezincingo zezwi/ividiyo eziyi-1:1 — ngaphandle kwenombolo yefoni, okhiye nemibhalo kudivayisi yakho.
I-Ghal Bol: ngesikhathi sangempela, ngasese, imilayezo nezincingo kusuka kudivayisi iye kweyinye

Umkhiqizo ophuma ngaphansi kophawu lwe-Ghal Bol — umbhalo ofihliwe usuka kudivayisi uye kweyinye, iziqinisekiso zokulethwa nokufundwa, nezincingo zendabuko zezwi nevidiyo phakathi kwabaku-inthanethi. Igama lomphakathi le-app ngu-Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Imilayezo ivalwa kudivayisi yakho. Ibhokisi lokulethwa ligcina umbhalo ofihliwe ongacacile kuze kube umamukeli uyaqinisekisa.
Izincingo zixhuma kusuka kudivayisi ziye kweyinye ku-LAN uma kungenzeka, kungenjalo ngebhruji elula yokuxhumanisa engakaze ikhiphe imfihlo kwemidiya.
Ukufakwa ngakunye kwenza ubunikazi bendawo bokufihla. Mema nge-QR noma isixhumanisi — ngaphandle kwenombolo yefoni nangaphandle kokungena komphakathi.
Isivakashi siskena i-QR yomgcini (noma sivula isixhumanisi sesimemo). Isivakashi sigcina ukhiye womphakathi womgcini bese sishayela. I-QR kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ayifuneki.
Yabelana ngesixhumanisi sakho esithi https://ghalbol.com/connect/… noma i-QR evela ku-Mema ku-Ghal Bol.
Bayivula ku-Ghal Bol (noma bayifaka kuqala ku-Play / Linux).
Uma bobabili befinyeleleka, ingxoxo nezincingo zixhuma — ezincingweni izindlela ze-LAN ne-WAN zihamba ndawonye.
Amaphakheji e-Windows akhiwa endaweni yomsebenzi efanayo. Ukulanda komphakathi kule sayithi yiphakheji yedeskithophu ye-Linux; i-Android iphuma ku-Google Play njenge-com.ghalbol.
Faka i-Ghal Bol ku-Play. Ama-App Links aqinisekisiwe avula izimemo ngqo ku-app uma kungenzeka.
Khipha ingobo yomlando yokukhishwa, bese ./install.sh (ngomsebenzisi ngamunye) noma ./run.sh ukuze uzame lapho.

I-Gotigin iwuphawu lokuhweba (Lapho ubuchwepheshe buhlangana nokutholwa). I-GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED iyinkampani. I-Ghal Bol iwuphawu lwemikhiqizo yezokuxhumana; le sayithi ngu-ghalbol.com. Isithunywa yilokho okuphuma namuhla. Amagama amaphakheji nedomeyini ahlala e-ghalbol — igama elilodwa. Alukho uphawu oluhlukile lwe-camel-case.
Iphakheji yokukhiqiza ye-x86_64. Khipha ingobo bese uqalisa i-./install.sh (ngomsebenzisi ngamunye, ku-~/.local) noma i-./run.sh ukuze uzame lapho.
Le bhrawuza eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ayikwazi ukuvula i-Ghal Bol. Thepha imenyu bese uvula leli khasi ku-Chrome, noma ukopishe isixhumanisi se-app usifake ku-Ghal Bol → Joyina.
Ngezansi thepha Vula ku-Ghal Bol. Uma kungasebenzi lutho, kopisha isixhumanisi se-app usifake ku-Ghal Bol (Joyina).
Ngena ku-Ghal Bol. Izinketho eziphelele — i-imeyili, i-Google, i-Microsoft, i-GitHub, noma ifoni.
Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
Sebenzisa inombolo yocingo ephelele enekhodi yezwe (isib. +91…).
Leyo khodi ye-SMS ayilungile noma iphelelwe yisikhathi.
I-imeyili ayikaqinisekiswa — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-imeyili yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — bheka ibhokisi lakho
Akukho lutho kuleli kheli. Isixhumanisi sesimemo sibukeka njenge-ghalbol.com/connect/… — hlola ukuthi sikopishwe ngokuphelele.
